summary: Tested office website GET /api/sito at 1280x800 end-to-end with the backend running live. Everything requested works: wrong password shows 'Password errata', the correct password opens the app, and PDF upload via #file fills the form with numero 25024298, consegna 2026-11-19, 9 rows, trasportatore Antolini s.r.l. and agenzia KÖLLA. An empty numero shows the validation error. Saving TEST_SITO_1 shows 'registrato (9 pedane)'. Saving the same order again opens the 'Ordine già esistente!' confirm; accepting shows 'sovrascritto (9 pedane)', and /pedane/duplicati confirms exactly 9 pedane, so the overwrite does not duplicate. On the Arrivi tab the date defaults to today (server date 2026-11-17), orders are grouped with badges, and changing the date to 2026-11-18 and back reloads the list. 'Aggiornato alle' is shown, and the 15s auto-refresh works: after a TEST magazziniere marked a pedana 'completo' through the API, the page showed 'Scaricata' and 'TEST_SitoWorker' without a reload, and the summary went from 0 to 1 scaricate. Esci clears the session token and shows the login again, and a reload stays logged out. Found 1 minor UI bug.

ui_bugs.issue: The red 'Password errata' banner stays visible after the next successful login, because enter() never clears #msg and error messages never auto-hide. The same stale banner would stay after a temporary auto-refresh error, even once refreshes succeed again. Reference: /app/backend/sito.html:116-120,154-159,249

issues: The summary badge 'N da scaricare' is computed as tot - completo, so pedane in 'parziale' are counted as 'da scaricare' and there is no separate parziale count (sito.html:238-240).
Rows with an empty Posizione are dropped silently on save (filter p => p.codice), with no warning (sito.html:210).
The drop zone is still clickable while a PDF is being read, so a second upload can start in parallel.

action_items: sito.html: clear #msg (className='msg') in enter() and at the start of each successful caricaArrivi()/importa()/salva().
Optional: add a 'parziali' badge in the Arrivi summary; warn when a row has data but no Posizione; disable the drop zone while a PDF is being read.
critical_code_review_comments: Output is escaped with esc() everywhere in the HTML; no XSS found.
The overwrite inserts the new pedane first and then deletes the old ones by id $nin, which is safe. The confirm dialog warns when pedane were already unloaded.
/api/sito is public, but every data call requires the ufficio bearer token, and a 401 logs the user out. OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (1 minor UI bug)

seed_data_creation: Created the TEST_SITO_1 order (9 pedane) and the TEST_SitoWorker magazziniere. Both were deleted by id afterwards. Real order 25024298 had 0 pedane before and after.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server date is 2026-11-17. Use sito_helper.py count|delete <numero> (delete only allowed for TEST_ numbers) and sito_worker_helper.py create|delete <id>, with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported. The test PDF parses to order 25024298 with 9 rows.
rca_of_issue: Stale banner: show() only auto-hides success messages (ok=true), and enter()/logout() never reset #msg.
